### A Brewer's Good Year

By Bay Tribune Business

---

In Uptown, the year closed well for Kwame Fitzgerald. The craft-brewery owner took on increased responsibilities this cycle — the kind of quiet step up that never makes a headline but tells you a small business has found its footing. At Thanksgiving, in a city breathing a little easier, it reads like the season itself: not a windfall, just a good year, earned one pour at a time.

------------------------------------------------------------ Fourteen and One The A's own the best record in baseball. They just lost their second starter. Now the real test begins. By Anthony | Bay Tribune Sports The number that keeps surfacing in any honest accounting of the Oakland Athletics this season is not the eleven-game winning streak, though that is the one everyone leads with. It is not the fourteen wins against a single loss, though that belongs on any short list of best starts in franchise history. The number is two — as in two months, as in the length of time Henry Rivas will spend on the injured list with a dislocated right shoulder, and as in the precise gap in the rotation that the rest of this organization now has to absorb. Oakland is very good. Oakland is also, as of this week, meaningfully more exposed than it was ten days ago.
